controls: Back up your stored user names and passwords
Restore your stored user names and passwords

If your user names and passwords are lost, damaged, or destroyed then you can use this backup to restore them. You can also use this backup to transfer your user names and passwords to other computers.
We recommend backing up user names and passwords on removable media instead of on your computer hard disk. This will make it easier to restore or transfer them if this computer is damaged.
This backup will include only logon credentials that you've asked Windows to remember. It will not include any credentials saved in your web browser.
If you saved the backup file on removable media, insert it before entering the location.
If you have added, changed, or removed any logon credentials since your last backup, those changes will be overwritten.
